```artifact
Feature: Maintain Doctors and Chemists/Labs
  As an administrator,
  I want to manage doctors and chemists/labs,
  So that I can ensure accurate and up-to-date information.

  Scenario: Attempt to access a non-existent speciality
    Given a speciality with ID "12345" does not exist
    When I attempt to access the speciality with ID "12345"
    Then an exception error message "Speciality does not exist" is displayed

  Scenario Outline: Add a new doctor
    Given I am on the Add Doctor Screen
    When I enter the following details:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | <Doctor Name> | <Age> | <Sex> | <Qualification> | <Experience> |
    And I submit the form
    Then a new doctor is added with a generated Doctor Id
    And the doctor details are as specified

    Examples:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | Dr. John Doe | 45 | Male | MBBS | 15 years |
      | Dr. Jane Smith | 30 | Female | MD | 5 years |
      | Dr. Alex Johnson | 50 | Male | PhD | 20 years |

  Scenario Outline: Edit an existing doctor
    Given I am on the Edit/Update Doctors Screen
    And a doctor with ID "<Doctor Id>" exists with the following details:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | <Doctor Name> | <Age> | <Sex> | <Qualification> | <Experience> |
    When I query the doctor with ID "<Doctor Id>"
    Then the doctor details are displayed as specified
    And I update the following details:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | <Updated Doctor Name> | <Updated Age> | <Updated Sex> | <Updated Qualification> | <Updated Experience> |
    And I submit the form
    Then the doctor details are updated as specified

    Examples:
      | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience | Updated Doctor Name | Updated Age | Updated Sex | Updated Qualification | Updated Experience |
      | 101 | Dr. John Doe | 45 | Male | MBBS | 15 years | Dr. John Doe | 46 | Male | MBBS | 16 years |
      | 102 | Dr. Jane Smith | 30 | Female | MD | 5 years | Dr. Jane Smith | 31 | Female | MD | 6 years |

  Scenario: Attempt to edit a non-existent doctor
    Given a doctor with ID "9999" does not exist
    When I attempt to edit the doctor with ID "9999"
    Then an exception error message "Doctor does not exist" is displayed

  Scenario: Attempt to delete a doctor with open consultation requests
    Given a doctor with ID "101" has open consultation requests
    When I attempt to delete the doctor with ID "101"
    Then an exception error message "Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete" is displayed

  Scenario Outline: Add a new chemist/lab
    Given I am on the Add Chemist/Lab Screen
    When I enter the following details:
      | Chemist/Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
      | <Chemist/Lab Flag> | <Chemist Lab Name> | <Chemist Lab Address> | <Chemist Lab Contact Details> |
    And I submit the form
    Then a new chemist/lab is added with a generated Chemist/Lab Id
    And the chemist/lab details are as specified

    Examples:
      | Chemist/Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
      | Chemist | Chemist Labs Inc. | 123 Main St, Anytown | 555-1234 |
      | Lab | Lab Services Inc. | 456 Elm St, Othertown | 555-5678 |
```
